releases.title: A brighter Triad, ready to update itself

sections.title: Automatic launcher updates
items: Triad now checks for a new build when it starts and downloads it in the background.
When the update is ready, restart Triad from the prompt or let it install when you close the launcher.
Accounts, instances, mods, worlds and settings stay in place.

sections.title: Every theme, everywhere
items: The selected theme now colours the background, sidebar, titlebar, glass panels and controls.
The Launcher colour picker recolours the whole shell, not just the buttons.
Frost keeps its primary buttons readable in the light theme.

sections.title: More skins
items: Added the solid Full Black and Full White skins.
Browse 628 skins with search, categories and your own PNG uploads.

sections.title: One-time patch notes
items: This screen appears after an update so you can see what changed.
It stays out of the way on later launches.
